controls.eclipse_model: Uniform circular discs in tangent plane; no atmospheric refraction, limb darkening or spatially varying penumbra.
controls.earthshine_model: Lambert sphere, geometric albedo 0.367; retarded Earth illumination and topocentric phase approximation excludes atmospheric and surface variation and eclipses
controls.geometry_limit: Anchor height is the recorded center sample, if available, otherwise zero; frame realization uncertainty and terrain outside the mesh are not modeled.
controls.visibility_limit: The local terrain casts shadows, but distant terrain and the lunar globe outside the mesh are not modeled as occluders.
